title: Supertext translation
intro: Supertext translates pages and pieces in Apostrophe's own workflow: open a page or piece, choose "Localize..." in its menu, select the locales and tick "Translate text content". The copies are saved as drafts.
keyMissing: Not set. Set the environment variable SUPERTEXT_API_KEY and restart the site.
apiKeyLink: Generate your API key at supertext.com → Integrations → API (requires the Admin role).
translationFailed: Supertext could not translate "{{ title }}" into {{ locale }}: {{ message }}
versionReportsHelp: Sends the site URL and the versions of this plugin, ApostropheCMS and the runtime to Supertext after an update and when the API key changes, so Supertext support can see which version you run. No content, no API key and no personal data are sent. Turn it off with the module option versionReports: false or SUPERTEXT_VERSION_REPORTS=0.
keyCheck_ok: API key checked: the connection to Supertext works.
keyCheck_invalid: Supertext rejected the API key. Check that you copied the whole key, or generate a new one at supertext.com → Integrations → API (requires the Admin role). No Supertext account yet? Create one at supertext.com.
keyCheck_missing: No API key is set yet. No Supertext account yet? Create one at supertext.com. Generate your API key at supertext.com → Integrations → API (requires the Admin role).
keyCheck_unreachable: The API key couldn't be checked because Supertext can't be reached. The settings are saved; check again later.
keyCheck_error: The API key couldn't be checked: Supertext answered with an error ({{ status }}). The settings are saved; check again later.
mappingHelp: Choose the Supertext language of each locale and save. The same code is used when the locale is the source. Locales you don't choose use Supertext's code if the locale name is one, else the default (de → de-DE, en → en-US, fr → fr-FR, it → it-IT, pt → pt-PT, zh → zh-Hans, es-ES → es …); the one preselected is that default.
notMapped: No Supertext language: choose one and save.
notInList: Not in Supertext's list of languages: check the code.
politenessNotOffered: Default (Supertext offers no formal or informal address for this language; the politeness setting is ignored)
error_missing_api_key: No Supertext API key is configured. Set the SUPERTEXT_API_KEY environment variable. No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin. Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role).
error_authentication_failure: Supertext rejected the API key. Please check it. No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin. Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role).
error_invalid_language_pair: Supertext doesn't translate this language pair ({{ detail }}). Ask your administrator to check the Supertext language of {{ locale }} in the admin bar under Supertext → Languages.
error_unsupported_language: The locale {{ locale }} has no Supertext language. Ask your administrator to choose one in the admin bar under Supertext → Languages.
error_unsupported_feature: Supertext offers no formal or informal address for {{ locale }}. Ask your administrator to set its form of address to Default in the admin bar under Supertext → Languages.
error_not_found: Supertext couldn't find the document ({{ detail }}). Please try again.
error_payload_too_large: The content is too large for Supertext to translate in one go.
error_too_many_requests: Too many requests to Supertext. Please try again in a moment.
error_service_unavailable: Supertext is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
error_unexpected_status: Supertext answered with an error (HTTP {{ status }}): {{ detail }}
error_no_file_id: Supertext didn't return a file ID. Please try again.
error_quota_exceeded: Your Supertext translation quota is used up.
error_file_deleted: The document was deleted at Supertext before the translation could be downloaded. Please try again.
error_timeout: The translation took too long. Please try again, or ask your administrator to raise the timeout option.
error_incomplete_response: Supertext returned an incomplete translation. Please try again.
sourceOnly: Source only: to translate into this locale, choose its Supertext language and save.
overridden: Set by the module option languages (it overrides this screen).
languagesInvalid: Not saved: invalid Supertext language for {{ locales }}.
